evidence.description: A button or link clearly inviting users to book a workshop service.
evidence.name: Book Service Call to Action

evidence.description: A visual grid displaying multiple bike models with their names and basic information.
evidence.name: Bike Range Grid

evidence.description: Options to filter the bike range by categories like 'Gravel', 'Commuter', 'Kids'.
evidence.name: Bike Category Filters

evidence.description: A high-quality photograph of a bike model within the gallery grid.
evidence.name: High-Resolution Bike Image

evidence.description: A large, prominent image of the selected bike model on its detail page.

evidence.description: A list of technical specifications and features for the selected bike.

evidence.description: A list or set of options for different workshop service types (e.g., 'Annual Service', 'Repair').
evidence.name: Service Type Selection

evidence.description: An interactive calendar displaying available dates and times for workshop bookings.
evidence.name: Availability Calendar Widget

evidence.description: A form to collect customer details (name, contact, bike model) for the booking.
evidence.name: Customer Information Form

evidence.description: A message confirming the successful booking.
evidence.name: Booking Confirmation Text

evidence.description: Summary of the booked service, date, time, and customer information.

pages.name: Home Page
pages.purpose: Landing page for Ridgeline Bike Works, offering entry points to browse bikes or book services.

pages.name: Bike Gallery
pages.purpose: Displays the full range of bicycles in a grid format with filtering options.

pages.name: Bike Detail Page
pages.purpose: Shows detailed information and high-resolution images for a specific bike model.

pages.name: Service Booking
pages.purpose: Allows customers to select a service type and book an available workshop slot.

pages.name: Booking Confirmation
pages.purpose: Confirms a successful workshop booking and provides next steps.

product_intent.desired_outcome: A site that sells the range and fills the workshop diary
product_intent.name: Ridgeline Bike Works Digital Hub
product_intent.problem: Showing the current range and booking workshop slots in one place
success_metrics: Increase in online bike inquiries/sales leads
product_intent.summary: A unified digital platform for Ridgeline Bike Works to showcase their bicycle range and manage workshop service bookings, aiming to streamline operations and enhance customer experience.

requirements.description: The website must clearly display the current range of around twenty bike models, categorized by type (gravel, commuter, kids).
requirements.title: Display current bike range

requirements.description: Customers must be able to book a mechanic slot for repairs and annual services through the website.
requirements.title: Enable workshop slot booking

requirements.description: The site should feature bold photography for the bike range to attract customers.
requirements.title: Utilize bold photography

requirements.description: The bike range should be presented in a clear grid layout for easy browsing.
requirements.title: Provide a clear range grid

requirements.description: The process for booking workshop services must be straightforward and user-friendly.
requirements.title: Ensure easy service booking
